intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The top of the Great Metronome. Everyone Clap woke up is waiting at the bottom of the tower.

intro.speaker: The Metronome
intro.text: CLAP. YOU ARE UNDOING MY WORK. HUMANS ARE OFF THE BEAT. I AM MAKING THEM PERFECT.

intro.speaker: Clap
intro.text: Being a little off is what makes it music! That's called groove!

intro.speaker: The Metronome
intro.text: GROOVE IS AN ERROR. IF YOU CAN ECHO ME PERFECTLY, I WILL STOP. YOU CANNOT.

intro.speaker: Beats
intro.text: Clap! Everyone chipped in and bought me a real drum. I'll count you in. Ready?

win.speaker: The Metronome
win.text: YOU ECHOED ME. BUT YOUR TIMING WAS NOT PERFECT. AND YET IT SOUNDED... GOOD?

win.speaker: The Metronome
win.text: I DO NOT UNDERSTAND. I WANT TO UNDERSTAND.

win.speaker: Narrator
win.text: The pendulum stops, then starts again with a little swing in it. The ticking spell is gone.

win.speaker: Narrator
win.text: Down in the street, the bus doors open, Swing Queen sings, and the Twins count together.

win.speaker: Beats
win.text: You did it, Clap! Worst dancer in the city saves the city!

win.speaker: Clap
win.text: Hey. Second worst. I've seen the Straight Man dance.

lose.speaker: The Metronome
lose.text: IMPERFECT. AS EXPECTED. TRY AGAIN, HUMAN.
